map.例：设定考试总时长 120 分钟；建议前 90 分钟作答、留 30 分钟检查。到: Example: set the exam length to 120 minutes; a good split is 90 minutes answering and 30 minutes left for checking. An early reminder (for example at 15 minutes remaining) avoids rushed answer sheets and missed questions.

map.启动时记录截止时刻 deadline = 当前时刻 + 设定总秒数，剩余秒数 =: On start, record a deadline = now + the configured total seconds; remaining = ceil((deadline − now) ÷ 1000), corrected to real time when you return from the background. Hours = floor(remaining ÷ 3600), minutes = floor((remaining mod 3600) ÷ 60), seconds = remaining mod 60. Pausing saves the remaining time and recomputes the deadline; reaching zero clears the timer and enters the stopped state.

map.进度 = (1 − 剩余秒数 ÷ 总秒数) × 100%；已用时长 = 总时长: Progress = (1 − remaining seconds ÷ total seconds) × 100%; elapsed = total duration − remaining time. Alerts (also written to history) fire at 25% / 50% / 75% and N minutes before the end; the exported table lists the same checkpoints.
map.剩余时间按截止时刻计算，切后台或锁屏不会因定时器节流而变慢，回到前台会自动校正；: Remaining time is computed from the deadline, so background throttling or a locked screen will not slow the countdown; it corrects itself when you return. A fully suspended page cannot sound an alert, so keep an alarm as a fallback for important mock exams.
